au-f2012l01123.summary: ADR 00/00 (Vehicle Standard (Australian Design Rule - Definitions and Vehicle Categories) 2005 Amendment 6) is a historic compilation made under the Motor Vehicle Standards Act 1989. It was in force from 30 May 2012 to 18 March 2014 and is no longer current.
au-f2012l01123._why: Finding: summary read as live and was truncated with '...'; record body says 'No longer in force', 30 May 2012 - 18 March 2014. Status/title already correct in record.

au-f2005l04012._why: ADR 19/02 is installation of lighting on L-group vehicles; R48 covers M/N/O only, R53 is the L3 installation counterpart. Wiring/Connectors not supported by title/body.

au-f2006l01280._why: ADR 30/01 is diesel smoke opacity, which adopts UN R24; R83/R168 are pollutant/RDE emissions.

au-f2006l01429._why: ADR 29/00 is static side door crush resistance (FMVSS 214 static alternative); R95 corresponds to dynamic side impact ADR 72/00.

au-f2006l01455._why: ADR 69/00 is full frontal impact; R94 is the offset-barrier regulation (ADR 73/00).

au-f2006l01786._why: ADR 21/00 Instrument Panel is an occupant-impact interior-fittings standard (UN R21); R121 covers control identification (ADR 18).

au-f2006l02312._why: ADR 66 covers seat/anchorage strength in omnibuses; R80 is the large-passenger-vehicle seat regulation, R17 is for M1/N.

au-f2006l02664._why: R162 is immobilizers, not locks; ADR 25/02 corresponds to R18 (Protection Against Unauthorised Use), now superseded by R116.

au-f2006l02729._why: ADR 54/00 is headlamps for mopeds; UN R56 is headlamps for mopeds. R112/R113 are for motor vehicles.

au-f2020l01254.summary: ADR 61/03 is the Australian Design Rule for vehicle marking, setting requirements for the marking of road vehicles so that they can be identified, including the vehicle identification plate.
au-f2020l01254._why: Finding: engine numbers, registration plates and tray visibility are not supported by the body (metadata page only); replaced with a conservative description supported by title and VIN plate tag.

au-f2023l01321._why: ADR 105/00 applies UN R151 (BSIS for bicycle detection) to medium/heavy goods vehicles; R158/R159 are reversing and MOIS. Not for passenger cars.

au-f2026l00278._why: ADR 107/00 is harmonised with UN R79 rev.4 (corrective steering function), not R157 (ALKS).
